newsitem.title: USA: Cordiant on track with rights issue goals.
newsitem.headline: Cordiant on track with rights issue goals.

text.p: Cordiant Plc Chairman Robert Seelert said Monday the company's revenue and profit margin will improve in the year ahead after a slight margin decline in the year just ended.

Seelert told a PaineWebber media conference here that the company was targeting margin improvements at its large Bates unit, and a reduction in the volatility of client turnover at its Saatchi & Saatchi unit.

The company boosted its overall topline revenue this year, but the cost was slight reduction in profitability. Seelert said the disappointing level of new business among major clients lead to a higher cost structure.
The company went through a major restructuring after the departure of its founder, Maurice Saatchi, in 1995. As part of that restructuring, it launched a major refinancing.
"We are on track with what we said we would do in the rights issue," Seelert said. "That was true in '96 and it will be true in '97."
